crossRefs.note: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
My soul shall be joyful in Yahweh. It shall rejoice in his salvation.
For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade…
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

translations.web: Sing to Yahweh! Praise Yahweh, for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.
translations.bsb: Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of evildoers.
translations.kjv: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
translations.asv: Sing unto Jehovah, praise ye Jehovah; for he hath delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evil-doers.
